answer: Work history is time-locked. Each record sits in a vault that opens 30 epochs after the first submission, so nothing cashes out early. A failed audit publishes the record in full with the sponsor chain attached. Replay compares text rather than names, which catches a sable account renamed after a ban. The garden looks healthy until the lock opens. Cost per attacker identity: 30 epochs of carry before one token is spendable, multiplied across every account at once.
